title: A Moon Shaped Pool
creator: Radiohead
summary: Radiohead's ninth album — string-heavy, mournful, their most openly sad record.
personalNote: Daydreaming is the best thing Radiohead have done since Kid A. The whole album feels like a reckoning — slower and more orchestral than anything before it. True Love Waits finally got its proper recorded version after twenty years of live performances. It was worth the wait and somehow sadder for it.
whyIReturn: Daydreaming on a long walk. Nothing else like it.
